title: Hearty Slovakian Cheese Casserole
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring a rich cheese pull and herbal flavors, cooked to perfection in a cataplana vessel. This lacto-vegetarian friendly recipe is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Spray the cataplana vessel with cataplana cooking spray to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, sour cream, demerara sugar, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the crumbled bryndza cheese, chopped parsley, and manteca to the bowl, stirring until a uniform mixture is achieved.
Pour the mixture into the prepared cataplana vessel.
Cover the cataplana vessel with a lid and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
